changeSet.author: dev
changeSet.comment:
Per-user service visibility (allow-list). A user with >= 1 row here can see AND order ONLY the listed services; a user with 0 rows is unrestricted (sees every active service); admins always bypass. Enforced in ServiceService.getActiveServicesForUser / validateUserAccessToService and at order creation (OrderService.createOrder, ClientApiController add / multi-add).
This table already exists in production (created out-of-band before it was under migration control), so CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS makes this a no-op there. The point of the changeset is fresh environments: without the table, the authenticated /api/v1/service/services path throws because countAccessEntriesForUser queries a missing relation. Idempotent SQL (matches the repo's existing "IF NOT EXISTS" changeset style) keeps prod untouched while giving new envs an identical schema.
